request: Net::HTTP: the connection method that sends a request object
code: Net::HTTP: Response#code, the status the server sent, as a string
body: Net::HTTP: Response#body, the body the server sent
get: Net::HTTP.get, which takes a URI, or a host, a path and a port
get_response: Net::HTTP.get_response, which takes a URI, or a host, a path and a port
get_print: Net::HTTP.get_print, which takes a URI, or a host, a path and a port
